application_overrides.name: Kansas Elevator Installation / Alteration Permit and Inspection
application_overrides.authority: Kansas State Fire Marshal / UG Building Inspection
documents: state elevator installation or alteration application

questions.label: Does the project install or alter an elevator, escalator, lift, or other regulated conveyance?
questions.help: Answer yes for new equipment or alterations to regulated conveyances.

applications.name: Kansas Construction Stormwater Authorization
applications.authority: Kansas Department of Health and Environment

questions.label: Will the project disturb one acre or more?
questions.help: Include clearing, grading, excavation, stockpiles, and staging.

questions.label: Is the work part of a larger common plan that will disturb one acre or more?
questions.help: A smaller project can still be covered when it belongs to a larger development.

applications.name: Kansas Demolition Notification
applications.authority: Kansas Department of Health and Environment

questions.label: Does demolition affect a commercial, public, institutional, industrial, or residential facility with more than four dwelling units?
questions.help: Kansas demolition notification generally applies to regulated facilities even when no asbestos is found.

applications.name: Kansas Asbestos Renovation / Abatement Notification
applications.authority: Kansas Department of Health and Environment

questions.label: Does the asbestos survey identify regulated asbestos material at or above a notification threshold?
questions.help: Upload the asbestos survey; EstatePermit will extract quantities when available.

applications.name: Kansas Boiler / Pressure Vessel Installation Approval

questions.label: Will the project install, replace, or alter a regulated boiler or pressure vessel?
questions.help: Answer yes for central heating boilers and other state-regulated pressure equipment.

questions.label: Will the project prepare, serve, store, or sell food to the public?
questions.help: Answer yes for restaurants, cafes, bars with food, groceries, commercial kitchens, and similar uses.

applications.name: Public or Semipublic Pool Plan Approval

questions.label: Will the project construct or alter a public or semipublic swimming or wading pool?
questions.help: Private family pools are treated separately by the building code.

applications.name: Public or Semipublic Pool Operator Permit

questions.label: Will the completed project operate a public or semipublic swimming or wading pool?
questions.help: The annual operator permit is separate from construction plan approval.

questions.label: Is the proposed operation in an EPA categorical pretreatment industry?
questions.help: Examples are listed in 40 CFR parts 405-471.

questions.label: Will the operation meet the significant industrial user definition?
questions.help: Upload process and wastewater information if uncertain.

questions.label: Could the operation discharge toxic, hazardous, or high-strength wastewater?
questions.help: This includes discharges that may interfere with municipal treatment.

questions.label: Will the project create, alter, or use construction access in KDOT highway right-of-way?
questions.help: EstatePermit will flag known state routes from address data when available; confirm project access.

questions.label: Will any utility work occupy or cross KDOT highway right-of-way?
questions.help: This is separate from the Unified Government right-of-way permit.

applications.name: Kansas Air Emission Construction Permit / Approval
applications.authority: Kansas Department of Health and Environment
documents: air construction application or approval record

questions.label: Will the project add or modify stationary equipment or processes that emit regulated air pollutants?
questions.help: Examples include industrial processes, large combustion equipment, coating, crushing, and material handling.

applications.name: USACE Section 404 Authorization
applications.authority: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Kansas City District
documents: permit application or nationwide permit verification

questions.label: Could the project discharge fill or excavated material into a stream, wetland, or other water?
questions.help: Upload a delineation or civil plan when the site contains drainage features or wetlands.

applications.name: USACE Section 408 Permission
applications.authority: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Kansas City District
documents: plans showing the federal project interface

questions.label: Will the work alter, occupy, or affect a federally authorized levee or other USACE civil works project?
questions.help: This applies independently of Section 404.

applications.name: Underground Fire-Service / Fire-Line Approval
applications.authority: Kansas City Kansas Fire Prevention / BPU

questions.label: Will the project install or alter a dedicated underground fire-service line?
questions.help: Answer yes when sprinklers, standpipes, or a fire pump require a new or changed fire-water connection.

questions.label: Will the building contain a new or altered standpipe system?
questions.help: Upload life-safety and fire-protection plans if uncertain.

questions.label: Will the project install or alter a fire pump?
questions.help: Answer yes when available water supply cannot satisfy the fire-protection design without a pump.

applications.name: Smoke-Control System Approval
applications.authority: Kansas City Kansas Fire Prevention / Building Inspection

questions.label: Does the code analysis require a smoke-control or smoke-exhaust system?
questions.help: Common triggers include atriums and some high-rise or large assembly designs.

applications.name: Emergency Responder Radio Coverage System Approval
documents: radio coverage survey or predictive design

questions.label: Has Fire Prevention required an emergency responder radio coverage system or test?
questions.help: A coverage test may establish that no enhancement system is needed.
